reason: Wendy's is a quick-service restaurant brand that serves prepared food to consumers through drive-thru, delivery and its app, and it is largely franchised. B&G Foods owns a portfolio of more than 50 packaged food brands. It makes shelf-stable and frozen foods and sells them to grocery and foodservice customers. The two companies don't overlap in product, customer or how they earn money.
reason_if_0: Different business model: Wendy's earns franchise royalties and restaurant sales, while B&G Foods earns revenue by manufacturing and selling packaged food to retailers.
